receipt_schema.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted keys; compact separators; no non-finite values

may: materialize an admitted base by immutable identity
run an approved deterministic build recipe
create an untrusted staged validator image
calculate OCI identities and produce a build receipt
may_not: publish to a shared trusted store
build_authority.model: Explicit scoped grant bound to base-admission receipt hash, Dockerfile hash, build-context manifest hash, build-engine identity, target platform, and output scope.

credential_boundary: Never embed credentials in validator images, validation bundles, candidate trees, receipts, or Git. Use only an already-approved secret mechanism; if none applies, network acquisition is unavailable pending separate authorization.

digest_policy.tag_use: Human-readable metadata only; never a trust identity or fallback.

excluded_authority: Controller or System Repair state mutation
automatic image rebuild during retrieval or validation
image_acceptance: approved base source and immutable source identities
deterministic build recipe and context identities
config digest and ordered rootfs layers recorded and verified
Python path, exact version, and binary SHA256 recorded; python -I works
read-only root filesystem, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, network isolation, and resource limits work
no production Controller files, project data, or embedded secrets
no SSH client/server or Docker socket unless separately justified and approved
no mutable package installation during validation
independent acceptance review passes before publication
durable bytes preserved and OCI archive round-trip preserves exact image identity

network.image_acquisition: Network only under an explicit scoped materialization grant for an approved source and immutable digest.

publication_authority.model: Separate explicit scoped authority; independent image-acceptance review precedes publication/admission.
receipt_binds: durable primary and secondary storage locations

receipt_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; lexicographically sorted keys; compact separators; no non-finite values.
receipt_identity.digest: SHA256 over canonical receipt payload bytes; receipt hash is stored outside the hashed payload.

reproducibility.build_inputs: Record exact base digest, Dockerfile, context manifest, build command, build-engine version, and platform.
reproducibility.identical_inputs: Require identical image identities across clean builds when the selected toolchain supports reproducible output.
reproducibility.result_identity: Freeze the accepted resulting image digest and platform/config/layer identities after review regardless of reproducibility support.

retrieval: resolve only an admitted receipt and immutable identity
retrieve only from its approved source
verify image/index, platform, manifest, config, and ordered layers
never fall back to a tag
